caption: The drawing depicts a single rooster positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The rooster's feathers are primarily a dark blue color with lighter blue highlights accentuating the patterns and contours of the plumage, especially on the tail and wing feathers. The comb and wattles on the rooster’s head are red, and the beak is yellow. The eye is detailed with a pale iris. The rooster’s legs are yellow, and its feet are covered with large, round, dark gray objects that resemble clogs or overshoes. There are no other objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Wooden Rooster
